info.name: Amplitude Evaluate Variants for a User

items.docs: Remotely evaluate all active experiments and feature flags for a specific user. Returns the variant assignments based on the user's properties and targeting rules. Amplitude automatically tracks an Experiment Assignment event for each evaluation.

Download all flag configurations for local evaluation. This endpoint returns the full flag configuration including targeting rules, variants, and segment definitions. Useful for bootstrapping client-side local evaluation SDKs with initialFlags or running evaluation in edge environments.
